title: Llama waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='75' rx='18' ry='11' fill='#e0c49a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#d4b685'/>
  <rect x='54' y='80' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#d4b685'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='92' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='92' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='48' y='38' width='13' height='30' rx='6' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <!-- neck shading -->
  <rect x='48' y='38' width='5' height='30' rx='3' fill='#e0c49a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='36' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#f5e2c0'/>
  <!-- head shading -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='39' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#e8d0a8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='25' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f0d9b5' transform='rotate(-15 45 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='25' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f0d9b5' transform='rotate(15 66 25)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='26' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#e8a0a0' transform='rotate(-15 45 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='26' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#e8a0a0' transform='rotate(15 66 26)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='43' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='51' cy='33' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='33' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#a08060'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#a08060'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M53 46 Q56 49 59 46' stroke='#a08060' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <rect x='62' y='55' width='6' height='22' rx='3' fill='#f0d9b5' transform='rotate(-35 62 55)'/>
  <!-- waving hoof -->
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='49' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <!-- motion lines -->
  <path d='M82 42 Q85 48 82 54' stroke='#ffd766' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M87 44 Q89 48 87 52' stroke='#ffd766' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='23' cy='66' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#e8c9a0'/>
</svg>
